notes: Total 60 as published; the Interrupts (10) and Effects (10) headers each undercount their lists (11 and 11).

Posted 'Counterarrack' (the strategy calls it 'Counterattack') dested the Dark Premiere Interrupt Counter Assault, the only Dark card of that kind; no card is named Counterattack.

Corporal Drazin is listed x3 as posted. Posted 'Deveastor' dested Devastator; 'Troper Assault' Trooper Assault; 'Elis Helrolt' Elis Helrot; 'An Entire Legion Of My Beast Troops' An Entire Legion Of My Best Troops; 'Srategic Reserves' Strategic Reserves; 'Imperial Aeerst Order' Imperial Arrest Order; 'Blaster Rifle' the Dark Premiere weapon; misspelt Cloud City sites (Securty Tower, Intergation Room, Downtown Pliza, Lower Corrior) dested the Dark Cloud City sites.
Byline 'michael "R2D5" patton' is title-cased to Michael Patton; the post is signed 'R5D4'. The description mentions Do Or Do Not, which is not in the list.
